description: This file defines a class 'ColorsCmyk' that generates visual representations of CMYK colors using the PDFsharp library, specifically within a snippet rendering context.

classes.name: ColorsCmyk
classes.description: A class that renders CMYK color samples as part of a PDF snippet.

methods.name: ColorsCmyk
methods.description: Constructor that sets the title of the snippet to 'CMYK Colors'.

methods.name: GetDeciRect
methods.description: Calculates and returns a rectangle for a given index, dividing the box width into tenths.

methods.name: RenderSnippet
methods.description: Renders multiple CMYK color rectangles with black outlines within a graphics context.
